title: HostApplicationDetailViewDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one organizer application for the Host response and offer pages: exactly the detail getOrganizerApplicationDetail returns, in detail. The answers are the submitted generic-form response or the immutable imported snapshot; a withdrawn, erased or mismatched response leaves no answers, outreach or membership and names a withdrawn applicant; outreach actions are derived from the answers on the server. Written by triggers on organizerApplications, organizerFormResponses, organizerApplicationResponses, organizerContactOrigins (the People link after a merge) and organizerCommunityMemberships; deleted with the application. Never identity, review or membership authority: the review and membership commands reread every source in their transactions and check the revisions the phone saw.
